What happens when you book

Booking happens in the Astrowani app. You pick an astrologer, choose whether to talk by chat, voice or video, and the session begins as soon as they accept. There is no appointment slot to wait for and no callback queue.

What to have ready

For anything read from your birth chart, have your date of birth, time of birth and place of birth to hand, and say at the start if the time is approximate rather than presenting a guess as exact. A tarot question or a general discussion needs no birth details at all. Writing down the one question you most want answered is worth more than it sounds — a vague opening uses up minutes.

How you are billed

Consultations are charged per minute at the rate shown on that astrologer's profile and taken from your Astrowani wallet. The meter runs only while you are connected, and you can end the session from your side whenever you choose. Your wallet is tied to your phone number, so a recharge made on the website is there the moment you open the app with the same number.

Your first consultation

New customers get a free introductory call, so you can hear how a reading goes before putting money in your wallet. The offer appears on your account when it applies — check its terms there, since eligibility and length can change.

If something goes wrong

If a call drops or a session never connects, you are not billed for minutes you did not talk for. For anything else — a payment you do not recognise, a session you want to query — email support@astrowani.com with the date and the astrologer's name. Our refund and cancellation policy sets out what can and cannot be refunded.

Do I need to book a time slot?

No. Astrologers are available through the day and a session starts when one accepts your request, usually within a minute or two. The directory shows who is free right now, so you are not booking against a calendar.

Can I have the consultation in Hindi?

Yes. Most astrologers on Astrowani consult in Hindi and English, and several work in other Indian languages as well. Every profile lists the languages that astrologer speaks, so you can choose before you connect.

What if the astrologer I want is busy?

A busy astrologer is in another consultation and will usually be free again shortly. You can open their profile to read their details and come back, or browse the full directory for someone else working in the same speciality.
